Hi there! I need some help with a few exchanges and a cancellation. I recently placed an order that included a bicycle, a jigsaw puzzle, and a camera. I’d like to exchange the bicycle for a larger frame size for my kid, and swap the jigsaw puzzle for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces—if possible, I’d prefer an animal theme over art. Also, I want to exchange the camera for one with a slightly lower resolution, but I’d like to keep the other features the same.

And, in a separate order, I’d like to cancel the skateboard. Can you help me with all of that?
I actually don’t remember which email I used, but my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. Let me know if you need anything else to look up my orders!
I don’t have the order numbers handy, sorry! If you could look up my recent orders and match the items, that would be great. I want to make sure we get the right ones.

Thanks for checking! I only want to exchange the jigsaw puzzle from order #W3916020, not the one from #W5416052. Yes, please exchange the bicycle from #W3916020 for a larger frame, and the camera from #W4689314 for a slightly lower resolution model with the same features.

For the skateboard in order #W8855135, I’d like to cancel just that item, and the reason is “no longer needed.” If it turns out you can’t cancel just the skateboard, I’m okay with cancelling the whole order instead. Let me know what’s possible!

Yes, that’s correct—I’ve listed everything I want to exchange and cancel. Please go ahead with the actions as described. Also, if there are any refunds or payments involved, I’d prefer to use my other card on file instead of the one used for the original purchase. Thanks for double-checking everything!

For the bicycle, the large, red, mountain bike sounds good—let’s go with that.

For the jigsaw puzzle, I’ll take the 1500-piece, animal-themed, intermediate difficulty option.

And for the camera, yes, please exchange it for the 20MP, 3x zoom, SD card model.

Thanks for using my other card ending in 6791 for any payments or refunds. Please go ahead with these choices!

That all sounds good—thanks for handling everything and for keeping me updated on the process. I’ll keep an eye out for the return instructions and refunds. I don’t have any other questions right now. Thanks again for your help! 

###STOP###
